entries.title: Psalms 127:1
segments: <<A Song of Ascents; of Solomon.>> Except Jehovah build the house, They labor in vain that build it: Except Jehovah keep the city, The watchman waketh but in vain.

entries.title: Psalms 127:2
segments: It is vain for you to rise up early, To take rest late, To eat the bread of toil; [For] so he giveth unto his beloved  sleep.

entries.title: Psalms 127:3
segments: Lo, children are a heritage of Jehovah; [And] the fruit of the womb is [his] reward.

entries.title: Psalms 127:4
segments: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the children of youth.

entries.title: Psalms 127:5
segments: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate.
